CREATE TABLE "public"."bookings" (
  "cancellation_reason" character varying,
  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "cancelled_by_id" uuid,
  "confirmed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_phone_number" character varying NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "room_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "start_at" time NOT NULL,
  "status" "booking_status" DEFAULT 'pending'::"booking_status" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."countries" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency_code" character(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "iso2_code" character(2) NOT NULL,
  "iso3_code" character(3) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying NOT NULL,
  "phone_code" character varying(6) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."features" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying,
  "icon_name" character varying,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."images" (
  "alt_text" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_primary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "url" character varying NOT NULL,
  "workspace_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."locations" (
  "area" character varying,
  "city" character varying,
  "country_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric,
  "longitude" numeric,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "locations_latitude_range_9dd11892" CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
  CONSTRAINT "locations_longitude_range_5fbf98d2" CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "message" character varying NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "recipient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "type" character varying NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."profiles" (
  "avatar_url" character varying,
  "bio" character varying,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "first_name" character varying NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "last_name" character varying NOT NULL,
  "location_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "phone_number" character varying,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."room_availabilities" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "day_of_week" "day_of_week" DEFAULT '1'::"day_of_week" NOT NULL,
  "end_at" time NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "room_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "start_at" time NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "room_availabilities_start_before_end_56d95790" CHECK (start_at < end_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."room_features" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "feature_details" character varying,
  "feature_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "room_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."room_unavailabilities" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "day_date" date NOT NULL,
  "end_at" time NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "reason" character varying,
  "room_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "start_at" time NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "room_unavailabilities_start_before_end_56d95790" CHECK (start_at < end_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rooms" (
  "capacity" int2 NOT NULL,
  "code" character varying(25) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying,
  "floor_number" int2 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "length_m" numeric(4,2) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying,
  "price_per_hour" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "width_m" numeric(4,2) NOT NULL,
  "workspace_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "rooms_capacity_positive_2e07dccc" CHECK (capacity > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "rooms_floor_number_positive_4e1289c1" CHECK (floor_number > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "rooms_length_positive_819b3405" CHECK (length_m > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "rooms_price_per_hour_positive_4c36d805" CHECK (price_per_hour > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "rooms_width_positive_4e0dd25f" CHECK (width_m > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying NOT NULL,
  "google_id" character varying,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "last_login_at" timestamptz,
  "password_hash" character varying,
  "role" "user_role" DEFAULT 'customer'::"user_role" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."workspace_availabilities" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "day_of_week" "day_of_week" DEFAULT '1'::"day_of_week" NOT NULL,
  "end_at" time NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "start_at" time NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "workspace_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "workspace_availabilities_start_before_end_56d95790" CHECK (start_at < end_at)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."workspaces" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" character varying,
  "floor_count" int2 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "location_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying NOT NULL,
  "owner_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug" character varying NOT NULL,
  "status" "workspace_status" DEFAULT 'active'::"workspace_status" NOT NULL,
  "timezone" character varying(50) DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "workspaces_floor_count_positive_5fcd4619" CHECK (floor_count > 0)
)
